text.en:
REPEALING CLAUSE. All executive orders, rules and regulations,
other issuances or parts thereof that shall be inconsistent
with the provisions of this
Executive order are hereby either revoked or modified accordingly.

EFFECTIVITY. This Executive Order shall take effect fifteen (15) days
after its publication
in at least one (1) national newspaper of general publication.
DONE in the City of Manila, thisLord,
Nin"eteen Hundred and Ninety-Six.
By the President:
